# .github/copilot-instructions.md

## 1. Core Instructions
* **Read Root Configs:** You must read and follow `AGENTS.md` and `requirements.md` at the project root before writing any code.

## Example: Copilot Redirection
* **Example:** If you are asked to write a feature, Copilot must respond: *"Checking requirements.md and AGENTS.md first to verify your project constraints and PLAN mode steps."*
